Which makes it interesting, given that tenures for the 2026‐27 crop range from newly appointed coaches to one with almost 15 years in charge. Some have managed more than 100 matches in the competition, others none. It gets under way on Tuesday with 14 of the 36 clubs led by managers who have been in the role for less than a year.
